+def close_settle_active(
+    now,
+):
+
+    d = read_json(
+        SETTLE_INPUT
+    )
+
+    try:
+
+        ts = float(
+            d["timestamp"]
+        )
+
+        age_s = (
+            now
+            -
+            ts
+        )
+
+        return bool(
+            d.get(
+                "active",
+                False,
+            )
+            and
+            0.0
+            <=
+            age_s
+            <=
+            MAX_SETTLE_AGE_S
+        )
+
+    except Exception:
+
+        return False
+
+
+def insertion_target_ready(
+    now,
+):
+
+    d = read_json(
+        INSERTION_TARGET_INPUT
+    )
+
+    try:
+
+        ts = float(
+            d["timestamp"]
+        )
+
+        age_s = (
+            now
+            -
+            ts
+        )
+
+        return bool(
+            d.get(
+                "target_ready",
+                False,
+            )
+            and
+            d.get(
+                "target_confirmed",
+                False,
+            )
+            and
+            d.get(
+                "phase",
+                "",
+            )
+            ==
+            "INSERTION_TRACKING"
+            and
+            0.0
+            <=
+            age_s
+            <=
+            MAX_INSERTION_TARGET_AGE_S
+        )
+
+    except Exception:
+
+        return False
